title: Forms and Input Elements
description: Introduction to creating interactive forms and using various input types.

flashcards.question: Which tag is used to create a form in HTML?
What attribute specifies where to send the form data upon submission?
What attribute defines the HTTP method to send form data?
Name three common input types used in forms.
flashcards.answer: text, password, email (also others like number, checkbox, radio, submit).

flashcards.question: Which tag is used for multi-line text input?
How do you group related options in a dropdown list?
flashcards.answer: Using the <select> tag with multiple <option> tags.

flashcards.question: What is the difference between checkbox and radio input types?
flashcards.answer: Checkboxes allow multiple selections; radio buttons allow only one selection within a group.

flashcards.question: Which attribute is used to make an input field required?
How do you add a label to an input for accessibility?
flashcards.answer: Using the <label> tag with the for attribute linked to the input's id.
